title: Getting started: × closes as Skip; Hide from account menu records the per-account flag (since #1216 the screen stays open); the row leaves the account menu and Help still reopens the screen
steps: S1: run the tracy-onboard mount and surface tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake /api/onboarding door) and the tracy-web onboarding door test (Postgres).
S2: the end-to-end form is S5 of tasks/evidence/ai-accounts-unify/stand/REPORT.md.
expect: × closes the screen as dismissed, leads nowhere and leaves the menu flag untouched.

Hide posts to /api/onboarding/menu-hide with the session cookie; since #1216 it no longer closes the screen (the button turns into Show in account menu, REG-PR-1216-getting-started-menu-show); a refused door (403) or no network never throws and never hangs the screen.
The desktop surface takes the close from the device and the menu flag from the account; hideMenu goes to the account door.
GET /api/onboarding answers {completedAt, menuHiddenAt}; the first menu-hide wins; 401 without a session.

tests: the header: × is Skip — closes as dismissed, leads nowhere, the menu flag untouched
the header: on a desktop app the toggle goes to the account door; a refused door (403) keeps the screen and says the flag did not change
hideMenu posts to /api/onboarding/menu-hide with the session cookie
hideMenu never fails the caller: a refused door and no network both resolve, warned once
the desktop surface: the close from this device, the menu flag from the account
